*I’d fix one issue before merging.*

*P1 — Normalization removes only the first space* — `src/normalize.js:4`
`replace(' ', '')` leaves subsequent spaces intact, so `queueText` rejects all three examples advertised in the README:
- `+44 20 7946 0958`
- `0044 20 7946 0958`
- `+1 (415) 555-0100`

For example, the first becomes `+4420 7946 0958` and throws `bad number` instead of queuing. Remove spaces globally and add end-to-end `queueText` tests for these formats; the current normalization test contains only one space, so it misses this.

Reviewed `phone-normalize` at `173e408` against `main`. All 5 existing tests pass; the reproductions above fail. No code changes made.
